$comment: Endpoints of the real-app e2e stack (client/scripts/e2e-stack.mjs, client/tests/e2e-app/stack.ts, client/scripts/build-e2e.mjs). Ports must match docker-compose.yml and supabase/config.toml next to this file. The publishable key is the Supabase CLI's fixed local-development key; e2e-stack.mjs checks the running project still reports it. The secret (service-role) key is deliberately not committed (GitHub push protection flags it): `up` writes the running project's key to infra/e2e/.run/supabase.json, which the tests read.
